text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali calls on Israeli troops to withdraw from South Lebanon.
- Abdellatif Filali sets up commission to look for ways to employ jobless graduates.
- Swaziland withdraws recognition of the Saharan Arab Democratic Republic (SADR).
- Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri discusses with his Moroccan counterpart ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation.
- Russia reiterates attachment to United Nations peace plan in Western Sahara.
- French Hotel group Accor buys Moroccan three-star hotels network for $5.3 million.
